preconditions.description: The number of vertices is between 1 and 3*10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges is between n-1 and 3*10^5, inclusive.
Each vertex has an integer di that can be -1, 0, or 1.
Each edge connects two vertices between 1 and n, inclusive.
The graph is guaranteed to be connected.

postconditions.description: The output is -1 if no good subset of edges exists.
The number of edges in the good subset is between 1 and m, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(edge_index in range(1, m+1) for edge_index in output_edges)
postconditions.description: The output edges are numbered from 1 to m, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(degree(v) % 2 == d[v] for v in vertices)
postconditions.description: For each vertex, the degree of the vertex modulo 2 is equal to its di.
